Name: TC_TIME_002 (negative): Select historical dates in My Attendance Records
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS
1. Stable internet connection
2. Use one of the following environments:
* Windows 11 / Google Chrome v149 / 1920x1080 / v5.8
* Linux 7.0 / Google Chrome v149 / 1920x1080 / v5.8
3. Navigate to URL: https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com
4. For the Employee usage
* Follow the TC: TC_PIM_001 (Positive): Add a new employee with valid
mandatory data
* Login with the Employee credentials made
5. Go to the module: TIME

REQUIREMENTS
TC_AUTH_Login_004(Positive): Verify sucessfull login with valid admin
credentials.
Objective:
Verify that the system correctly validates user input by rejecting invalid
historical dates (e.g., non-existent days or incorrect formats) in the
Attendance records, displaying an appropriate error message.
Step:
1. Navigate to URL: https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com
2. Type '[Employee_Username]' in the Username field
3. Type '[Employee_Password]' in the Password field
4. Click the 'Login' button
